notes: All 25 candidates are individual in-memoriam notices on the Caltech Alumni Association site (alumni.caltech.edu/in-memoriam/...). Each page is a navigation shell around one deceased alumnus's name and Caltech degree years (e.g. 'Lionel J. Skidmore (PhD '64)'); most carry no body text at all, some link to an external obituary PDF on darmedia.caltech.edu or 'Link to obituary'. None states a department, dissertation or first job except the Dimitri Mihalas page, which is an obituary of an astrophysicist (Caltech PhD '64, then Princeton faculty), a field outside operations/management. None lists graduates of a program, so all are marked not-a-list rather than single-record; the degrees date from 1937-1971 and the alumni are Caltech science/engineering graduates, not an operations or management program. Institution by host (California Institute of Technology) is correct for every page. Nothing here is usable for the dataset.
